paragraphs: Niyuli said in the name of Rav Huna ([Chullin 45b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.45b.14)).[^1][^2][^3]

notes.text: The Bavli makes the direction of the citation explicit. Niyuli transmits a teaching in Rav Huna’s name.

[Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Chullin.45b.14.1) explains that Niyuli is a sage’s name. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2709&lang=en) quotes the same transmission and cites Rashi.
Hyman gives only the attribution. The linked passage gives Rav Huna’s teaching about the spinal cord.
